title: rhobound.readiness/v1
description: An environment's readiness record (ARCHITECTURE.md 6.6): the four conditions under which enforce mode is earned. CI writes it from ledger records. The first build has no ledger: the gate parses, checks and echoes the file in gate.json, and every verdict stays advisory with gate.enforce_not_earned whatever the file says.

pairs.description: A/A pairs measured at the gated load; at least 10

floor_ms.description: the false-delta floor by entry; a threshold below it is threshold_under_floor

n.description: injected changes judged; n_seeded is 40 by default

p_value.description: exact binomial test of exceedances against the nominal rate

required.description: false when the gate takes no measured labels

passed.description: the transfer study passed its pre-registered criterion, not merely ran
every gated window's trace entry rate within 5% of an outside count
